_comment: Where each agent looks for skills / rules / slash commands. Source: each vendor's documentation, checked 2026-11-20 (the Cline and Kiro skill folders are not yet confirmed in their own docs). Shared by installer/install.py and bin/trust-kitchen.js. In command texts, {skills_dir} is replaced by the agent's skills folder.

commands.text:
description = "Trust Kitchen: /tk [command] [args], e.g. /tk review 42"
prompt = """
Load the FULL {skills_dir}/tk/SKILL.md, read all of it, and follow it exactly.

ARGUMENTS: {{args}}
"""

---
description: Trust Kitchen - /tk [command] [args], e.g. /tk review 42
---

Load the FULL {skills_dir}/tk/SKILL.md, read all of it, and follow it exactly.

ARGUMENTS: $ARGUMENTS
